newsitem.title: USA: Jason to buy 51 pct of German supplier.
newsitem.headline: Jason to buy 51 pct of German supplier.

text.p: Jason Inc said Wednesday that it signed an agreement in principle to acquire 51 percent of Suroflex GmbH, a German manufacturer of non-woven insulation products for the automotive industry.
Suroflex has annual sales of about $15 million.
Jason said Suroflex would become part of its automotive group, which is currently the largest manufacturer of automotive fiber insulation products in the United States.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in late October. Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

"The automotive industry has become a truly global business in the last several years, and this acquisition will allow Jason and Suroflex to serve their U.S. and European customers on a worldwide basis," Vincent Martin, Jason's chairman, said in a statement.
He added that Jason intended to introduce its new Marabond thermoplastic product to the German automotive market and will bring some Suroflex products to the United States.
